method: Viewed all six scientific figures; rechecked final pooled RTD and parameter-constraint title margins after PDF layout correction; independent PDF text bounds passed for every figure.
findings: Plain RT-only DDMs improve RT shape markedly but still miss sharp peaks; the natural drift-direction interpretation predicts near-deterministic choices at small differences. Joint fits recover graded choices and again have overly broad RTDs. Posterior predictive averaging leaves the original TIED mismatch.
